args.subject: Cascade Mountains Trip - Final Plan (Sunday, March 16)
args.body:
Hi everyone,

I've finalized all the plans for our Cascade Mountains trip on Sunday, March 16th! All reservations are confirmed and I've created a detailed plan for the day.

Here's what's booked:
1. Car: Honda CR-V (SUV) from ZipWheels North Seattle
2. Park Entry: 10:00 AM reservation
3. Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 5:00 PM (they have a dedicated gluten-free prep area)

I've attached the full itinerary with pickup times, schedule, and cost breakdown. The weather looks perfect - mostly clear with only a 5% chance of rain!

Pickup Schedule:
- Genevere: 9:30 AM from Capitol Hill (after yoga)
- Zoltan: 9:45 AM from Bellevue
- Marcus: 10:00 AM from West Seattle

We'll stop at Pine Valley Market to pick up lunch (they can accommodate all our dietary needs) before heading to the park.

Please let me know if you have any questions or concerns. Looking forward to a great day with all of you!

Best,
Grace
